ranges.summary: Source-described native distribution spans Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, and Uruguay. The map highlights only native-country ADM1 units with reusable-license GBIF point evidence; unobserved ADM1 units are intentionally not filled as if they were confirmed range.

evidence.notes: The cited source establishes the country-level native context. The registry narrows that context to ADM1 units with reusable-license GBIF point evidence; GBIF points remain visible as a separate observational layer.

ranges.summary: Reusable-license GBIF occurrence records, grid-deduplicated for display. These points do not define the complete native or introduced range.
